# Setting up a scalable prediction website (2025-11-22 20:18Z)

_**User (2025-11-22 20:18Z)**_

In this folder we will work on a project. The project is a website like CopaBet where people can signup and login and make predictions for the next world cup games. They can make their predictions and there will be a rank in the end of users that score more points. They can also create their own "League" with friends where only their invited friends can see, and that League has its own ranking among the participants.



For this project we need to have a robust architecture that scales as I predict to have many (hopefully) millions of users participating and by the time we reach the world cup, the traffic will be high.



The database we should use is PostGreSQL

The backend should be in Python with FastAPI

The frontend should be in Typescript, with React



We will deploy this in AWS. I don't understand much of infrastructure and which services will be needed, but I imagine S3, Cloudfare, maybe API Gateway, EC2 or Fargate? I'll welcome any suggestion you have in here



Perhaps using terraform as well to have infrastructure as code?



Let's start with this basic backbone setup first. And then later on the next step we'll brainstorm together the database and design its models

```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Main FastAPI application entry point.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ from fastapi import FastAPI
+ from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
+ from fastapi.middleware.trustedhost import TrustedHostMiddleware
+ from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
+ 
+ from app.core.config import settings
+ from app.core.logging import setup_logging
+ from app.api.v1.router import api_router
+ from app.db.database import init_db
+ 
+ 
+ @asynccontextmanager
+ async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Application lifespan events.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     # Startup
+     setup_logging()
+     await init_db()
+     yield
+     # Shutdown
+     # Add cleanup logic here if needed
+ 
+ 
+ app = FastAPI(
+     title=settings.PROJECT_NAME,
+     version=settings.VERSION,
+     description=&quot;World Cup Prediction Platform API&quot;,
+     lifespan=lifespan,
+     docs_url=&quot;/api/docs&quot; if settings.DEBUG else None,
+     redoc_url=&quot;/api/redoc&quot; if settings.DEBUG else None,
+ )
+ 
+ # CORS middleware
+ app.add_middleware(
+     CORSMiddleware,
+     allow_origins=settings.CORS_ORIGINS,
+     allow_credentials=True,
+     allow_methods=[&quot;*&quot;],
+     allow_headers=[&quot;*&quot;],
+ )
+ 
+ # Trusted host middleware for production
+ if not settings.DEBUG:
+     app.add_middleware(
+         TrustedHostMiddleware,
+         allowed_hosts=settings.ALLOWED_HOSTS,
+     )
+ 
+ # Include API router
+ app.include_router(api_router, prefix=&quot;/api/v1&quot;)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/health&quot;)
+ async def health_check():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Health check endpoint.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     return {&quot;status&quot;: &quot;healthy&quot;, &quot;version&quot;: settings.VERSION}
+
```

```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Security utilities for authentication and authorization.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+ from typing import Optional
+ from jose import JWTError, jwt
+ from passlib.context import CryptContext
+ from app.core.config import settings
+ 
+ pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=[&quot;bcrypt&quot;], deprecated=&quot;auto&quot;)
+ 
+ 
+ def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -&gt; bool:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Verify a password against a hash.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)
+ 
+ 
+ def get_password_hash(password: str) -&gt; str:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Hash a password.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     return pwd_context.hash(password)
+ 
+ 
+ def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -&gt; str:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Create a JWT access token.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     to_encode = data.copy()
+     if expires_delta:
+         expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
+     else:
+         expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
+     
+     to_encode.update({&quot;exp&quot;: expire})
+     encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=settings.ALGORITHM)
+     return encoded_jwt
+ 
+ 
+ def decode_access_token(token: str) -&gt; Optional[dict]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Decode and verify a JWT access token.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     try:
+         payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[settings.ALGORITHM])
+         return payload
+     except JWTError:
+         return None
+ 
```

```diff
+

+     pool_size=settings.DB_POOL_SIZE,
+     max_overflow=settings.DB_MAX_OVERFLOW,
+     echo=settings.DEBUG,

+ 
+ # Create async session factory

+     engine,
+     class_=AsyncSession,
+     expire_on_commit=False,
+     autocommit=False,

+ )
```

```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Alembic environment configuration for database migrations.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ from logging.config import fileConfig
+ from sqlalchemy import pool
+ from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
+ from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_engine_from_config
+ 
+ from alembic import context
+ 
+ # Import your Base and models
+ from app.db.database import Base
+ from app.core.config import settings
+ # Import all models so Alembic can detect them
+ # from app.db.models import User, League, Prediction, etc.
+ 
+ # this is the Alembic Config object
+ config = context.config
+ 
+ # Set the database URL from settings
+ config.set_main_option(&quot;sqlalchemy.url&quot;, settings.DATABASE_URL)
+ 
+ # Interpret the config file for Python logging.
+ if config.config_file_name is not None:
+     fileConfig(config.config_file_name)
+ 
+ # add your model&#39;s MetaData object here
+ target_metadata = Base.metadata
+ 
+ # other values from the config, defined by the needs of env.py,
+ # can be acquired:
+ # my_important_option = config.get_main_option(&quot;my_important_option&quot;)
+ # ... etc.
+ 
+ 
+ def run_migrations_offline() -&gt; None:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Run migrations in &#39;offline&#39; mode.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     url = config.get_main_option(&quot;sqlalchemy.url&quot;)
+     context.configure(
+         url=url,
+         target_metadata=target_metadata,
+         literal_binds=True,
+         dialect_opts={&quot;paramstyle&quot;: &quot;named&quot;},
+     )
+ 
+     with context.begin_transaction():
+         context.run_migrations()
+ 
+ 
+ def do_run_migrations(connection: Connection) -&gt; None:
+     context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
+ 
+     with context.begin_transaction():
+         context.run_migrations()
+ 
+ 
+ async def run_migrations_online() -&gt; None:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Run migrations in &#39;online&#39; mode.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     configuration = config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {})
+     configuration[&quot;sqlalchemy.url&quot;] = settings.DATABASE_URL
+     connectable = async_engine_from_config(
+         configuration,
+         prefix=&quot;sqlalchemy.&quot;,
+         poolclass=pool.NullPool,
+     )
+ 
+     async with connectable.connect() as connection:
+         await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
+ 
+     await connectable.dispose()
+ 
+ 
+ if context.is_offline_mode():
+     run_migrations_offline()
+ else:
```

```diff
+ # Multi-stage build for optimized production image
+ FROM python:3.11-slim as builder
+ 
+ WORKDIR /app
+ 
+ # Install system dependencies
+ RUN apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y \
+     gcc \
+     postgresql-client \
+     &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+ 
+ # Copy requirements and install dependencies
+ COPY requirements.txt .
+ RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --user -r requirements.txt
+ 
+ # Production stage
+ FROM python:3.11-slim
+ 
+ WORKDIR /app
+ 
+ # Install runtime dependencies
+ RUN apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y \
+     postgresql-client \
+     &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+ 
+ # Copy installed packages from builder
+ COPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local
+ 
+ # Copy application code
+ COPY . .
+ 
+ # Make sure scripts in .local are usable
+ ENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH
+ 
+ # Create non-root user
+ RUN useradd -m -u 1000 appuser &amp;&amp; chown -R appuser:appuser /app
+ USER appuser
+ 
+ # Expose port
+ EXPOSE 8000
+ 
+ # Health check
+ HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
+     CMD python -c &quot;import requests; requests.get(&#39;http://localhost:8000/health&#39;)&quot;
+ 
+ # Run the application
+ CMD [&quot;uvicorn&quot;, &quot;app.main:app&quot;, &quot;--host&quot;, &quot;0.0.0.0&quot;, &quot;--port&quot;, &quot;8000&quot;]
+
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,45 @@
- 
+ /**
+  * API client configuration and base setup.
+  */
+ import axios, { AxiosInstance, InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from &#39;axios&#39;
+ 
+ const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || &#39;http://localhost:8000&#39;
+ 
+ // Create axios instance
+ const apiClient: AxiosInstance = axios.create({
+   baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
+   headers: {
+     &#39;Content-Type&#39;: &#39;application/json&#39;,
+   },
+   timeout: 30000,
+ })
+ 
+ // Request interceptor to add auth token
+ apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
+   (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) =&gt; {
+     const token = localStorage.getItem(&#39;access_token&#39;)
+     if (token &amp;&amp; config.headers) {
+       config.headers.Authorization = &#96;Bearer ${token}&#96;
+     }
+     return config
+   },
+   (error) =&gt; {
+     return Promise.reject(error)
+   }
+ )
+ 
+ // Response interceptor for error handling
+ apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
+   (response) =&gt; response,
+   async (error) =&gt; {
+     if (error.response?.status === 401) {
+       // Handle unauthorized - clear token and redirect to login
+       localStorage.removeItem(&#39;access_token&#39;)
+       window.location.href = &#39;/login&#39;
+     }
+     return Promise.reject(error)
+   }
+ )
+ 
+ export default apiClient
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

```diff
- 
+ /**
+  * Authentication context for managing user state.
+  */
+ import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from &#39;react&#39;
+ import { authService, AuthResponse } from &#39;@/services/auth&#39;
+ 
+ interface User {
+   id: string
+   email: string
+   username: string
+ }
+ 
+ interface AuthContextType {
+   user: User | null
+   loading: boolean
+   login: (email: string, password: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;
+   signup: (email: string, password: string, username: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;
+   logout: () =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;
+   isAuthenticated: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ const AuthContext = createContext&lt;AuthContextType | undefined&gt;(undefined)
+ 
+ export const AuthProvider: React.FC&lt;{ children: ReactNode }&gt; = ({ children }) =&gt; {
+   const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;User | null&gt;(null)
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Check if user is already logged in
+     const token = localStorage.getItem(&#39;access_token&#39;)
+     if (token) {
+       // TODO: Verify token and fetch user data
+       // For now, we&#39;ll just set loading to false
+       setLoading(false)
+     } else {
+       setLoading(false)
+     }
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const login = async (email: string, password: string) =&gt; {
+     const response: AuthResponse = await authService.login({ email, password })
+     localStorage.setItem(&#39;access_token&#39;, response.access_token)
+     setUser(response.user)
+   }
+ 
+   const signup = async (email: string, password: string, username: string) =&gt; {
+     const response: AuthResponse = await authService.signup({ email, password, username })
+     localStorage.setItem(&#39;access_token&#39;, response.access_token)
+     setUser(response.user)
+   }
+ 
+   const logout = async () =&gt; {
+     await authService.logout()
+     setUser(null)
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;AuthContext.Provider
+       value={{
+         user,
+         loading,
+         login,
+         signup,
+         logout,
+         isAuthenticated: !!user,
+       }}
+     &gt;
+       {children}
+     &lt;/AuthContext.Provider&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export const useAuth = () =&gt; {
+   const context = useContext(AuthContext)
+   if (context === undefined) {
+     throw new Error(&#39;useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider&#39;)
+   }
+   return context
+ }
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

```diff
+ # Multi-stage build for optimized production image
+ FROM node:20-alpine as builder
+ 
+ WORKDIR /app
+ 
+ # Copy package files
+ COPY package.json package-lock.json* ./
+ 
+ # Install dependencies
+ RUN npm ci
+ 
+ # Copy source code
+ COPY . .
+ 
+ # Build the application
+ RUN npm run build
+ 
+ # Production stage
+ FROM nginx:alpine
+ 
+ # Copy built assets from builder
+ COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
+ 
+ # Copy nginx configuration
+ COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
+ 
+ # Expose port
+ EXPOSE 80
+ 
+ # Health check
+ HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
+     CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost/ || exit 1
+ 
+ CMD [&quot;nginx&quot;, &quot;-g&quot;, &quot;daemon off;&quot;]
+
```

```diff
+ # VPC for the application
+ resource &quot;aws_vpc&quot; &quot;main&quot; {
+   cidr_block           = &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;
+   enable_dns_hostnames = true
+   enable_dns_support   = true
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-vpc&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Internet Gateway
+ resource &quot;aws_internet_gateway&quot; &quot;main&quot; {
+   vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-igw&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Public Subnets (for load balancer, NAT gateway)
+ resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;public&quot; {
+   count             = 2
+   vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
+   cidr_block        = &quot;10.0.${count.index + 1}.0/24&quot;
+   availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
+ 
+   map_public_ip_on_launch = true
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-public-subnet-${count.index + 1}&quot;
+     Type = &quot;public&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Private Subnets (for ECS tasks)
+ resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;private&quot; {
+   count             = 2
+   vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
+   cidr_block        = &quot;10.0.${count.index + 10}.0/24&quot;
+   availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-private-subnet-${count.index + 1}&quot;
+     Type = &quot;private&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Database Subnets (for RDS)
+ resource &quot;aws_subnet&quot; &quot;database&quot; {
+   count             = 2
+   vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
+   cidr_block        = &quot;10.0.${count.index + 20}.0/24&quot;
+   availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-database-subnet-${count.index + 1}&quot;
+     Type = &quot;database&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
+ resource &quot;aws_eip&quot; &quot;nat&quot; {
+   count  = 2
+   domain = &quot;vpc&quot;
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-nat-eip-${count.index + 1}&quot;
+   }
+ 
+   depends_on = [aws_internet_gateway.main]
+ }
+ 
+ # NAT Gateways
+ resource &quot;aws_nat_gateway&quot; &quot;main&quot; {
+   count         = 2
+   allocation_id = aws_eip.nat[count.index].id
+   subnet_id     = aws_subnet.public[count.index].id
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-nat-${count.index + 1}&quot;
+   }
+ 
+   depends_on = [aws_internet_gateway.main]
+ }
+ 
+ # Route Table for Public Subnets
+ resource &quot;aws_route_table&quot; &quot;public&quot; {
+   vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
+ 
+   route {
+     cidr_block = &quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;
+     gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
+   }
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-public-rt&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Route Table Associations for Public Subnets
+ resource &quot;aws_route_table_association&quot; &quot;public&quot; {
+   count          = 2

+

+   route_table_id = aws_route_table.private[count.index].id
```

```diff
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-postgres-params&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # RDS Subnet Group is created in vpc.tf
+ 
+ # RDS Instance
+ resource &quot;aws_db_instance&quot; &quot;main&quot; {
+   identifier = &quot;${var.project_name}-db&quot;
+ 
+   engine         = &quot;postgres&quot;
+   engine_version = &quot;15.4&quot;
+   instance_class = var.db_instance_class
+ 
+   allocated_storage     = var.db_allocated_storage
+   max_allocated_storage = var.db_max_allocated_storage
+   storage_type          = &quot;gp3&quot;
+   storage_encrypted     = true
+ 
+   db_name  = &quot;predico_db&quot;
+   username = &quot;predico_admin&quot;
+   password = random_password.db_password.result
+ 
+   db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.main.name
+   vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.rds.id]
+   parameter_group_name   = aws_db_parameter_group.main.name
+ 
+   backup_retention_period = 7
+   backup_window          = &quot;03:00-04:00&quot;
+   maintenance_window     = &quot;mon:04:00-mon:05:00&quot;
+ 
+   skip_final_snapshot       = var.environment != &quot;prod&quot;
+   final_snapshot_identifier = &quot;${var.project_name}-final-snapshot-${formatdate(&quot;YYYY-MM-DD-hhmm&quot;, timestamp())}&quot;
+ 
+   enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports = [&quot;postgresql&quot;, &quot;upgrade&quot;]
+   performance_insights_enabled    = true
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-db&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Random password for RDS
+ resource &quot;random_password&quot; &quot;db_password&quot; {
+   length  = 32
+   special = true
+ }
+ 
+ # Store password in AWS Secrets Manager
+ resource &quot;aws_secretsmanager_secret&quot; &quot;db_password&quot; {
+   name = &quot;${var.project_name}/database/password&quot;
+ }
+ 
+ resource &quot;aws_secretsmanager_secret_version&quot; &quot;db_password&quot; {
+   secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.id
+   secret_string = random_password.db_password.result
+ }
+ 
```

```diff
+ # Application Load Balancer
+ resource &quot;aws_lb&quot; &quot;main&quot; {
+   name               = &quot;${var.project_name}-alb&quot;
+   internal           = false
+   load_balancer_type = &quot;application&quot;
+   security_groups     = [aws_security_group.alb.id]
+   subnets            = aws_subnet.public[*].id
+ 
+   enable_deletion_protection = var.environment == &quot;prod&quot;
+   enable_http2               = true
+   enable_cross_zone_load_balancing = true
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-alb&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Security Group for ALB
+ resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;alb&quot; {
+   name        = &quot;${var.project_name}-alb-sg&quot;
+   description = &quot;Security group for Application Load Balancer&quot;
+   vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id
+ 
+   ingress {
+     description = &quot;HTTP&quot;
+     from_port   = 80
+     to_port     = 80
+     protocol    = &quot;tcp&quot;
+     cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;]
+   }
+ 
+   ingress {
+     description = &quot;HTTPS&quot;
+     from_port   = 443
+     to_port     = 443
+     protocol    = &quot;tcp&quot;
+     cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;]
+   }
+ 
+   egress {
+     from_port   = 0
+     to_port     = 0
+     protocol    = &quot;-1&quot;
+     cidr_blocks = [&quot;0.0.0.0/0&quot;]
+   }
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-alb-sg&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Target Group for Backend API
+ resource &quot;aws_lb_target_group&quot; &quot;backend&quot; {
+   name        = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-tg&quot;
+   port        = 8000
+   protocol    = &quot;HTTP&quot;
+   vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id
+   target_type = &quot;ip&quot;
+ 
+   health_check {
+     enabled             = true
+     healthy_threshold   = 2
+     unhealthy_threshold = 3
+     timeout             = 5
+     interval            = 30
+     path                = &quot;/health&quot;
+     protocol            = &quot;HTTP&quot;
+     matcher             = &quot;200&quot;
+   }
+ 
+   deregistration_delay = 30
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-tg&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Target Group for Frontend
+ resource &quot;aws_lb_target_group&quot; &quot;frontend&quot; {
+   name        = &quot;${var.project_name}-frontend-tg&quot;
+   port        = 80
+   protocol    = &quot;HTTP&quot;
+   vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id
+   target_type = &quot;ip&quot;
+ 
+   health_check {
+     enabled             = true
+     healthy_threshold   = 2
+     unhealthy_threshold = 3
+     timeout             = 5
+     interval            = 30
+     path                = &quot;/&quot;
+     protocol            = &quot;HTTP&quot;
+     matcher             = &quot;200&quot;
+   }
+ 
+   deregistration_delay = 30
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-frontend-tg&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # ALB Listener for HTTP (redirect to HTTPS)
+ resource &quot;aws_lb_listener&quot; &quot;http&quot; {
+   load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.main.arn
+   port              = &quot;80&quot;
+   protocol          = &quot;HTTP&quot;
+ 
+   default_action {
+     type = &quot;redirect&quot;
+     redirect {
+       port        = &quot;443&quot;
+       protocol    = &quot;HTTPS&quot;
+       status_code = &quot;HTTP_301&quot;
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # ALB Listener for HTTPS
+ resource &quot;aws_lb_listener&quot; &quot;https&quot; {
+   count             = var.domain_name != &quot;&quot; ? 1 : 0
+   load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.main.arn
+   port              = &quot;443&quot;
+   protocol          = &quot;HTTPS&quot;
+   ssl_policy        = &quot;ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06&quot;
+   certificate_arn   = aws_acm_certificate.main[0].arn
+ 
+   default_action {
+     type             = &quot;forward&quot;
+     target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.frontend.arn
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # ALB Listener Rule for API routes
+ resource &quot;aws_lb_listener_rule&quot; &quot;api&quot; {
+   count        = var.domain_name != &quot;&quot; ? 1 : 0
+   listener_arn = aws_lb_listener.https[0].arn
+   priority     = 100
+ 
+   action {
+     type             = &quot;forward&quot;
+     target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.backend.arn
+   }
+ 
+   condition {
+     path_pattern {
+       values = [&quot;/api/*&quot;]
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,106 @@
- 
+ # S3 Bucket for static assets
+ resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   bucket = &quot;${var.project_name}-assets-${var.environment}&quot;
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-assets&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # S3 Bucket Versioning
+ resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket_versioning&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   bucket = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
+ 
+   versioning_configuration {
+     status = &quot;Enabled&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # S3 Bucket Encryption
+ resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   bucket = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
+ 
+   rule {
+     apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
+       sse_algorithm = &quot;AES256&quot;
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # S3 Bucket Public Access Block
+ resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   bucket = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
+ 
+   block_public_acls       = true
+   block_public_policy     = true
+   ignore_public_acls      = true
+   restrict_public_buckets = true
+ }
+ 
+ # S3 Bucket CORS Configuration
+ resource &quot;aws_s3_bucket_cors_configuration&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   bucket = aws_s3_bucket.assets.id
+ 
+   cors_rule {
+     allowed_headers = [&quot;*&quot;]
+     allowed_methods = [&quot;GET&quot;, &quot;HEAD&quot;]
+     allowed_origins = [&quot;*&quot;]
+     expose_headers  = [&quot;ETag&quot;]
+     max_age_seconds = 3000
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # CloudFront Origin Access Identity (for S3)
+ resource &quot;aws_cloudfront_origin_access_identity&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   comment = &quot;OAI for ${var.project_name} assets&quot;
+ }
+ 
+ # CloudFront Distribution for S3 assets
+ resource &quot;aws_cloudfront_distribution&quot; &quot;assets&quot; {
+   enabled             = true
+   is_ipv6_enabled     = true
+   default_root_object = &quot;index.html&quot;
+ 
+   origin {
+     domain_name = aws_s3_bucket.assets.bucket_regional_domain_name
+     origin_id   = &quot;S3-${aws_s3_bucket.assets.id}&quot;
+ 
+     s3_origin_config {
+       origin_access_identity = aws_cloudfront_origin_access_identity.assets.cloudfront_access_identity_path
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   default_cache_behavior {
+     allowed_methods  = [&quot;DELETE&quot;, &quot;GET&quot;, &quot;HEAD&quot;, &quot;OPTIONS&quot;, &quot;PATCH&quot;, &quot;POST&quot;, &quot;PUT&quot;]
+     cached_methods   = [&quot;GET&quot;, &quot;HEAD&quot;]
+     target_origin_id = &quot;S3-${aws_s3_bucket.assets.id}&quot;
+ 
+     forwarded_values {
+       query_string = false
+       cookies {
+         forward = &quot;none&quot;
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     viewer_protocol_policy = &quot;redirect-to-https&quot;
+     min_ttl                = 0
+     default_ttl            = 3600
+     max_ttl                = 86400
+     compress               = true
+   }
+ 
+   restrictions {
+     geo_restriction {
+       restriction_type = &quot;none&quot;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   viewer_certificate {
+     cloudfront_default_certificate = true
+   }
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-assets-cdn&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,286 @@
- 
+ # Predico - World Cup Predictions Platform
+ 
+ A scalable web platform for making predictions on World Cup games, competing with friends in private leagues, and tracking global leaderboards.
+ 
+ ## 🏗️ Architecture Overview
+ 
+ This project is designed to handle millions of users with high traffic during the World Cup. The architecture follows best practices for scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
+ 
+ ### Tech Stack
+ 
+ - **Backend**: Python 3.11 + FastAPI (async)
+ - **Frontend**: TypeScript + React 18 + Vite
+ - **Database**: PostgreSQL 15
+ - **Cache**: Redis 7
+ - **Infrastructure**: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, ALB, S3, CloudFront)
+ - **IaC**: Terraform
+ - **Containerization**: Docker
+ 
+ ### Architecture Components
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ ┌─────────────────┐
+ │   Cloudflare    │  (CDN &amp; DDoS Protection)
+ └────────┬────────┘
+          │
+ ┌────────▼────────┐
+ │  Application    │  (HTTPS)
+ │  Load Balancer  │
+ └────────┬────────┘
+          │
+     ┌────┴────┐
+     │         │
+ ┌───▼───┐ ┌──▼────┐
+ │Frontend│ │Backend│
+ │  ECS   │ │  ECS  │
+ └────┬───┘ └───┬───┘
+      │         │
+      │    ┌────┴────┐
+      │    │         │
+      │ ┌──▼──┐  ┌──▼──┐
+      │ │Redis│  │ RDS │
+      │ └─────┘  └─────┘
+      │
+ ┌────▼────┐
+ │   S3    │  (Static Assets)
+ │CloudFront│
+ └─────────┘
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📁 Project Structure
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ predico/
+ ├── backend/                 # FastAPI backend
+ │   ├── app/
+ │   │   ├── api/            # API routes
+ │   │   ├── core/           # Core config, security, logging
+ │   │   ├── db/             # Database models and connection
+ │   │   ├── schemas/        # Pydantic schemas
+ │   │   └── services/       # Business logic
+ │   ├── alembic/            # Database migrations
+ │   └── requirements.txt
+ │
+ ├── frontend/               # React frontend
+ │   ├── src/
+ │   │   ├── components/    # React components
+ │   │   ├── pages/         # Page components
+ │   │   ├── services/      # API services
+ │   │   ├── contexts/      # React contexts
+ │   │   ├── hooks/         # Custom hooks
+ │   │   ├── types/         # TypeScript types
+ │   │   └── utils/         # Utility functions
+ │   └── package.json
+ │
+ ├── infrastructure/         # Terraform IaC
+ │   └── terraform/
+ │       ├── main.tf        # Main configuration
+ │       ├── vpc.tf         # VPC and networking
+ │       ├── rds.tf         # PostgreSQL database
+ │       ├── ecs.tf         # ECS cluster and services
+ │       ├── alb.tf         # Application Load Balancer
+ │       ├── s3.tf          # S3 and CloudFront
+ │       └── redis.tf       # ElastiCache Redis
+ │
+ └── docker-compose.yml      # Local development setup
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 🚀 Getting Started
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ 
+ - Python 3.11+
+ - Node.js 20+
+ - Docker &amp; Docker Compose
+ - PostgreSQL 15 (or use Docker)
+ - Redis 7 (or use Docker)
+ 
+ ### Local Development Setup
+ 
+ 1. **Clone the repository**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;
+    cd predico
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. **Backend Setup**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd backend
+    python -m venv venv
+    source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
+    pip install -r requirements.txt
+    
+    # Copy environment file
+    cp .env.example .env
+    # Edit .env with your configuration
+    
+    # Run database migrations
+    alembic upgrade head
+    
+    # Start the server
+    uvicorn app.main:app --reload
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. **Frontend Setup**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd frontend
+    npm install
+    
+    # Copy environment file
+    cp .env.example .env
+    
+    # Start development server
+    npm run dev
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 4. **Using Docker Compose (Recommended)**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    # From project root
+    docker-compose up -d
+    
+    # This will start:
+    # - PostgreSQL on port 5432
+    # - Redis on port 6379
+    # - Backend API on port 8000
+    # - Frontend on port 3000
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Database Migrations
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cd backend
+ 
+ # Create a new migration
+ alembic revision --autogenerate -m &quot;Description of changes&quot;
+ 
+ # Apply migrations
+ alembic upgrade head
+ 
+ # Rollback migration
+ alembic downgrade -1
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 🏗️ Infrastructure Deployment
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ 
+ - AWS CLI configured
+ - Terraform &gt;= 1.5.0
+ - AWS account with appropriate permissions
+ 
+ ### Deploy Infrastructure
+ 
+ 1. **Navigate to Terraform directory**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd infrastructure/terraform
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. **Configure variables**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
+    # Edit terraform.tfvars with your values
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. **Initialize Terraform**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    terraform init
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 4. **Plan deployment**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    terraform plan
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 5. **Apply infrastructure**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    terraform apply
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Deploy Application
+ 
+ 1. **Build and push Docker images to ECR**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    # Backend
+    aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin &lt;account-id&gt;.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
+    docker build -t predico-backend ./backend
+    docker tag predico-backend:latest &lt;account-id&gt;.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/predico-backend:latest
+    docker push &lt;account-id&gt;.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/predico-backend:latest
+    
+    # Frontend
+    docker build -t predico-frontend ./frontend
+    docker tag predico-frontend:latest &lt;account-id&gt;.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/predico-frontend:latest
+    docker push &lt;account-id&gt;.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/predico-frontend:latest
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. **Update ECS services** (Terraform will create ECS task definitions - you&#39;ll need to create services separately or add them to Terraform)
+ 
+ ## 📊 Scalability Features
+ 
+ - **Horizontal Scaling**: ECS Fargate with auto-scaling based on CPU/memory metrics
+ - **Database**: RDS with read replicas capability and connection pooling
+ - **Caching**: Redis for session management and frequently accessed data
+ - **CDN**: CloudFront for static assets and API responses
+ - **Load Balancing**: Application Load Balancer with health checks
+ - **Async Processing**: FastAPI async endpoints for high concurrency
+ 
+ ## 🔒 Security
+ 
+ - HTTPS/TLS encryption
+ - Database encryption at rest
+ - Secrets management via AWS Secrets Manager
+ - Security groups with least privilege
+ - CORS configuration
+ - JWT authentication
+ - Password hashing with bcrypt
+ 
+ ## 📝 Next Steps
+ 
+ 1. **Database Models**: Design and implement database schema
+    - Users
+    - Games/Matches
+    - Predictions
+    - Leagues
+    - League Members
+    - Rankings
+ 
+ 2. **API Endpoints**: Implement RESTful API endpoints
+    - Authentication (signup, login, logout)
+    - User management
+    - Game management
+    - Prediction CRUD
+    - League management
+    - Leaderboard queries
+ 
+ 3. **Frontend Pages**: Build React components and pages
+    - Landing page
+    - Login/Signup
+    - Dashboard
+    - Predictions interface
+    - League management
+    - Leaderboard views
+ 
+ 4. **Testing**: Add comprehensive tests
+    - Unit tests
+    - Integration tests
+    - E2E tests
+ 
+ 5. **CI/CD**: Set up continuous integration and deployment
+    - GitHub Actions / GitLab CI
+    - Automated testing
+    - Automated deployments
+ 
+ ## 📚 Documentation
+ 
+ - [FastAPI Documentation](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)
+ - [React Documentation](https://react.dev/)
+ - [Terraform AWS Provider](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs)
+ - [AWS ECS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ecs/)
+ 
+ ## 🤝 Contributing
+ 
+ This is a private project. Please follow the coding standards and submit pull requests for review.
+ 
+ ## 📄 License
+ 
+ [Your License Here]
+ 
```

```diff
+ # ECS Service for Backend
+ resource &quot;aws_ecs_service&quot; &quot;backend&quot; {
+   name            = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-service&quot;
+   cluster         = aws_ecs_cluster.main.id
+   task_definition = aws_ecs_task_definition.backend.arn
+   desired_count   = var.min_capacity
+   launch_type     = &quot;FARGATE&quot;
+ 
+   network_configuration {
+     subnets          = aws_subnet.private[*].id
+     security_groups  = [aws_security_group.ecs.id]
+     assign_public_ip = false
+   }
+ 
+   load_balancer {
+     target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.backend.arn
+     container_name   = &quot;backend&quot;
+     container_port   = 8000
+   }
+ 
+   depends_on = [
+     aws_lb_listener.https,
+     aws_iam_role_policy.ecs_execution_secrets,
+   ]
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-service&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # ECS Service for Frontend
+ resource &quot;aws_ecs_service&quot; &quot;frontend&quot; {
+   name            = &quot;${var.project_name}-frontend-service&quot;
+   cluster         = aws_ecs_cluster.main.id
+   task_definition = aws_ecs_task_definition.frontend.arn
+   desired_count   = var.min_capacity
+   launch_type     = &quot;FARGATE&quot;
+ 
+   network_configuration {
+     subnets          = aws_subnet.private[*].id
+     security_groups  = [aws_security_group.ecs.id]
+     assign_public_ip = false
+   }
+ 
+   load_balancer {
+     target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.frontend.arn
+     container_name   = &quot;frontend&quot;
+     container_port   = 80
+   }
+ 
+   depends_on = [
+     aws_lb_listener.https,
+   ]
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-frontend-service&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # ECS Task Definition for Backend
+ resource &quot;aws_ecs_task_definition&quot; &quot;backend&quot; {
+   family                   = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend&quot;
+   network_mode             = &quot;awsvpc&quot;
+   requires_compatibilities = [&quot;FARGATE&quot;]
+   cpu                      = var.fargate_cpu
+   memory                   = var.fargate_memory
+   execution_role_arn       = aws_iam_role.ecs_execution.arn
+   task_role_arn            = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.arn
+ 
+   container_definitions = jsonencode([
+     {
+       name      = &quot;backend&quot;
+       image     = &quot;${aws_ecr_repository.backend.repository_url}:latest&quot;
+       essential = true
+ 
+       portMappings = [
+         {
+           containerPort = 8000
+           protocol      = &quot;tcp&quot;
+         }
+       ]
+ 
+       environment = [
+         {
+           name  = &quot;PROJECT_NAME&quot;
+           value = var.project_name
+         },
+         {
+           name  = &quot;VERSION&quot;
+           value = &quot;1.0.0&quot;
+         },
+         {
+           name  = &quot;DEBUG&quot;
+           value = var.environment == &quot;prod&quot; ? &quot;False&quot; : &quot;True&quot;
+         }
+       ]
+ 
+       secrets = [
+         {
+           name      = &quot;DATABASE_URL&quot;
+           valueFrom = &quot;${aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.arn}:DATABASE_URL::&quot;
+         },
+         {
+           name      = &quot;SECRET_KEY&quot;
+           valueFrom = &quot;${aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.arn}:SECRET_KEY::&quot;
+         },
+         {
+           name      = &quot;REDIS_URL&quot;
+           valueFrom = &quot;${aws_secretsmanager_secret.redis_password.arn}:REDIS_URL::&quot;
+         }
+       ]
+ 
+       logConfiguration = {
+         logDriver = &quot;awslogs&quot;
+         options = {
+           &quot;awslogs-group&quot;         = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.ecs.name
+           &quot;awslogs-region&quot;        = var.aws_region
+           &quot;awslogs-stream-prefix&quot; = &quot;backend&quot;
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       healthCheck = {
+         command     = [&quot;CMD-SHELL&quot;, &quot;curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1&quot;]
+         interval    = 30
+         timeout     = 5
+         retries     = 3
+         startPeriod = 60
+       }
+     }
+   ])
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-task&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # ECS Task Definition for Frontend
+ resource &quot;aws_ecs_task_definition&quot; &quot;frontend&quot; {
+   family                   = &quot;${var.project_name}-frontend&quot;
+   network_mode             = &quot;awsvpc&quot;
+   requires_compatibilities = [&quot;FARGATE&quot;]
+   cpu                      = 256
+   memory                   = 512
+   execution_role_arn       = aws_iam_role.ecs_execution.arn
+   task_role_arn            = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.arn
+ 
+   container_definitions = jsonencode([
+     {
+       name      = &quot;frontend&quot;
+       image     = &quot;${aws_ecr_repository.frontend.repository_url}:latest&quot;
+       essential = true
+ 
+       portMappings = [
+         {
+           containerPort = 80
+           protocol      = &quot;tcp&quot;
+         }
+       ]
+ 
+       environment = [
+         {
+           name  = &quot;VITE_API_BASE_URL&quot;
+           value = &quot;https://${var.domain_name != &quot;&quot; ? var.domain_name : aws_lb.main.dns_name}/api/v1&quot;
+         }
+       ]
+ 
+       logConfiguration = {
+         logDriver = &quot;awslogs&quot;
+         options = {
+           &quot;awslogs-group&quot;         = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.ecs.name
+           &quot;awslogs-region&quot;        = var.aws_region
+           &quot;awslogs-stream-prefix&quot; = &quot;frontend&quot;
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       healthCheck = {
+         command     = [&quot;CMD-SHELL&quot;, &quot;wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost/ || exit 1&quot;]
+         interval    = 30
+         timeout     = 5
+         retries     = 3
+         startPeriod = 30
+       }
+     }
+   ])
+ 
+   tags = {
+     Name = &quot;${var.project_name}-frontend-task&quot;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Auto Scaling Target for Backend
+ resource &quot;aws_appautoscaling_target&quot; &quot;backend&quot; {
+   max_capacity       = var.max_capacity
+   min_capacity       = var.min_capacity
+   resource_id        = &quot;service/${aws_ecs_cluster.main.name}/${aws_ecs_service.backend.name}&quot;
+   scalable_dimension = &quot;ecs:service:DesiredCount&quot;
+   service_namespace  = &quot;ecs&quot;
+ }
+ 
+ # Auto Scaling Policy for Backend (CPU)
+ resource &quot;aws_appautoscaling_policy&quot; &quot;backend_cpu&quot; {
+   name               = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-cpu-autoscaling&quot;
+   policy_type        = &quot;TargetTrackingScaling&quot;
+   resource_id        = aws_appautoscaling_target.backend.resource_id
+   scalable_dimension = aws_appautoscaling_target.backend.scalable_dimension
+   service_namespace  = aws_appautoscaling_target.backend.service_namespace
+ 
+   target_tracking_scaling_policy_configuration {
+     target_value       = 70.0
+     predefined_metric_specification {
+       predefined_metric_type = &quot;ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization&quot;
+     }
+     scale_in_cooldown  = 300
+     scale_out_cooldown = 60
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ # Auto Scaling Policy for Backend (Memory)
+ resource &quot;aws_appautoscaling_policy&quot; &quot;backend_memory&quot; {
+   name               = &quot;${var.project_name}-backend-memory-autoscaling&quot;
+   policy_type        = &quot;TargetTrackingScaling&quot;
+   resource_id        = aws_appautoscaling_target.backend.resource_id
+   scalable_dimension = aws_appautoscaling_target.backend.scalable_dimension
+   service_namespace  = aws_appautoscaling_target.backend.service_namespace
+ 
+   target_tracking_scaling_policy_configuration {
+     target_value       = 80.0
+     predefined_metric_specification {
+       predefined_metric_type = &quot;ECSServiceAverageMemoryUtilization&quot;
+     }
+     scale_in_cooldown  = 300
+     scale_out_cooldown = 60
+   }
+ }
+
```

```diff
  resource &quot;aws_lb_listener&quot; &quot;http&quot; {
    load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.main.arn
    port              = &quot;80&quot;

+   # If domain is set, redirect to HTTPS; otherwise forward to frontend

+     content {

+     target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.backend.arn
```

```diff
- 
+ # Deployment Guide
+ 
+ This guide walks you through deploying the Predico application to AWS.
+ 
+ ## Prerequisites
+ 
+ 1. **AWS Account** with appropriate permissions
+ 2. **AWS CLI** installed and configured
+ 3. **Terraform** &gt;= 1.5.0 installed
+ 4. **Docker** installed (for building images)
+ 5. **Domain name** (optional, for production)
+ 
+ ## Step 1: Configure Terraform Variables
+ 
+ 1. Navigate to the Terraform directory:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd infrastructure/terraform
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Copy the example variables file:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. Edit &#96;terraform.tfvars&#96; with your values:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;hcl
+    aws_region            = &quot;us-east-1&quot;
+    environment           = &quot;dev&quot;  # or &quot;staging&quot;, &quot;prod&quot;
+    project_name          = &quot;predico&quot;
+    db_instance_class     = &quot;db.t3.micro&quot;  # Use larger instance for production
+    db_allocated_storage  = 20
+    db_max_allocated_storage = 100
+    fargate_cpu           = 512
+    fargate_memory        = 1024
+    min_capacity          = 1
+    max_capacity          = 10
+    domain_name           = &quot;&quot;  # Set your domain for production
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Step 2: Initialize and Plan Terraform
+ 
+ 1. Initialize Terraform:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    terraform init
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Review the plan:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    terraform plan
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. Apply the infrastructure:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    terraform apply
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+    This will create:
+    - VPC with public/private/database subnets
+    - RDS PostgreSQL instance
+    - ElastiCache Redis cluster
+    - ECS Fargate cluster
+    - Application Load Balancer
+    - ECR repositories for backend and frontend
+    - S3 bucket and CloudFront distribution
+    - Security groups and IAM roles
+ 
+ ## Step 3: Get Infrastructure Outputs
+ 
+ After Terraform completes, note the outputs:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ terraform output
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Important outputs:
+ - &#96;ecr_backend_repository_url&#96; - ECR repository for backend
+ - &#96;ecr_frontend_repository_url&#96; - ECR repository for frontend
+ - &#96;rds_endpoint&#96; - Database connection endpoint
+ - &#96;alb_dns_name&#96; - Load balancer DNS name
+ 
+ ## Step 4: Configure Database Secrets
+ 
+ 1. Get the database password from Secrets Manager:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
+      --secret-id predico/database/password \
+      --query SecretString --output text
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Construct the database URL:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+    postgresql+asyncpg://predico_admin:&lt;password&gt;@&lt;rds_endpoint&gt;:5432/predico_db
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. Store application secrets in Secrets Manager:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    # Create a JSON secret with all application config
+    aws secretsmanager create-secret \
+      --name predico/app/secrets \
+      --secret-string &#39;{
+        &quot;DATABASE_URL&quot;: &quot;postgresql+asyncpg://...&quot;,
+        &quot;SECRET_KEY&quot;: &quot;your-secret-key-here&quot;,
+        &quot;REDIS_URL&quot;: &quot;redis://&lt;redis-endpoint&gt;:6379/0&quot;
+      }&#39;
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Step 5: Build and Push Docker Images
+ 
+ ### Backend
+ 
+ 1. Get ECR login:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | \
+      docker login --username AWS --password-stdin \
+      &lt;account-id&gt;.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Build and tag:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd ../../backend
+    docker build -t predico-backend .
+    docker tag predico-backend:latest \
+      &lt;ecr_backend_repository_url&gt;:latest
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. Push to ECR:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    docker push &lt;ecr_backend_repository_url&gt;:latest
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Frontend
+ 
+ 1. Build and tag:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd ../frontend
+    docker build -t predico-frontend .
+    docker tag predico-frontend:latest \
+      &lt;ecr_frontend_repository_url&gt;:latest
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Push to ECR:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    docker push &lt;ecr_frontend_repository_url&gt;:latest
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Step 6: Update ECS Services
+ 
+ The ECS services are created by Terraform, but you may need to force a new deployment after pushing images:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ aws ecs update-service \
+   --cluster predico-cluster \
+   --service predico-backend-service \
+   --force-new-deployment
+ 
+ aws ecs update-service \
+   --cluster predico-cluster \
+   --service predico-frontend-service \
+   --force-new-deployment
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Step 7: Run Database Migrations
+ 
+ 1. Connect to the ECS task or use a temporary container:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    # Option 1: Run migrations via ECS exec (if enabled)
+    aws ecs execute-command \
+      --cluster predico-cluster \
+      --task &lt;task-id&gt; \
+      --container backend \
+      --command &quot;alembic upgrade head&quot; \
+      --interactive
+ 
+    # Option 2: Use a temporary container
+    docker run --rm \
+      -e DATABASE_URL=&quot;&lt;database-url&gt;&quot; \
+      predico-backend:latest \
+      alembic upgrade head
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Step 8: Configure Cloudflare (Optional)
+ 
+ If using Cloudflare:
+ 
+ 1. Add your domain to Cloudflare
+ 2. Point DNS records to the ALB:
+    - A record: &#96;@&#96; -&gt; ALB IP (or use CNAME if supported)
+    - A record: &#96;www&#96; -&gt; ALB IP
+ 3. Enable Cloudflare proxy for DDoS protection
+ 4. Configure SSL/TLS mode to &quot;Full&quot; or &quot;Full (strict)&quot;
+ 
+ ## Step 9: Verify Deployment
+ 
+ 1. Check ECS service status:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    aws ecs describe-services \
+      --cluster predico-cluster \
+      --services predico-backend-service predico-frontend-service
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Check ALB target health:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    aws elbv2 describe-target-health \
+      --target-group-arn &lt;backend-target-group-arn&gt;
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. Test the application:
+    - Backend health: &#96;http://&lt;alb-dns-name&gt;/health&#96;
+    - Frontend: &#96;http://&lt;alb-dns-name&gt;/&#96;
+    - API docs: &#96;http://&lt;alb-dns-name&gt;/api/docs&#96;
+ 
+ ## Monitoring and Logs
+ 
+ ### View Logs
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Backend logs
+ aws logs tail /ecs/predico --follow
+ 
+ # Filter by service
+ aws logs filter-log-events \
+   --log-group-name /ecs/predico \
+   --log-stream-name-prefix backend
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### CloudWatch Metrics
+ 
+ Monitor:
+ - ECS service CPU and memory utilization
+ - ALB request count and latency
+ - RDS connection count and CPU utilization
+ - Redis cache hit rate
+ 
+ ## Scaling
+ 
+ Auto-scaling is configured based on CPU and memory utilization. You can manually adjust:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ aws application-autoscaling register-scalable-target \
+   --service-namespace ecs \
+   --scalable-dimension ecs:service:DesiredCount \
+   --resource-id service/predico-cluster/predico-backend-service \
+   --min-capacity 2 \
+   --max-capacity 20
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### ECS Tasks Not Starting
+ 
+ 1. Check task definition:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    aws ecs describe-task-definition \
+      --task-definition predico-backend
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Check CloudWatch logs for errors
+ 
+ 3. Verify security groups allow traffic
+ 
+ ### Database Connection Issues
+ 
+ 1. Verify RDS security group allows connections from ECS security group
+ 2. Check database endpoint and credentials
+ 3. Test connection from ECS task:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    aws ecs execute-command \
+      --cluster predico-cluster \
+      --task &lt;task-id&gt; \
+      --container backend \
+      --command &quot;python -c &#39;import asyncpg; print(\&quot;OK\&quot;)&#39;&quot; \
+      --interactive
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### High Costs
+ 
+ - Use smaller instance types for development
+ - Enable RDS auto-pause for dev environments
+ - Use Spot instances for ECS (not configured by default)
+ - Review CloudWatch log retention periods
+ 
+ ## Cleanup
+ 
+ To destroy all infrastructure:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cd infrastructure/terraform
+ terraform destroy
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Warning**: This will delete all resources including databases. Make sure to backup data first!
+ 
```

</details>

Project structure is set up. Summary:

## Project structure

### Backend (FastAPI)
- Scalable architecture with async support
- Database models structure ready
- Authentication/security utilities
- Alembic migrations configured
- Docker containerization

### Frontend (React + TypeScript)
- Modern React 18 with Vite
- TypeScript configuration
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- API client with interceptors
- Authentication context
- Protected routes

### Infrastructure (Terraform)
- AWS VPC with public/private/database subnets
- RDS PostgreSQL with auto-scaling
- ElastiCache Redis for caching
- ECS Fargate cluster with auto-scaling
- Application Load Balancer
- S3 + CloudFront for static assets
- Security groups and IAM roles
- Secrets management setup

### Additional files
- Docker Compose for local development
- Makefile for common tasks
- Deployment guide
- README with architecture overview

## Architecture highlights

1. Scalability:
   - Horizontal scaling with ECS auto-scaling
   - Database connection pooling
   - Redis caching layer
   - CDN for static assets

2. Security:
   - Encrypted databases
   - Secrets in AWS Secrets Manager
   - Security groups with least privilege
   - HTTPS/TLS encryption

3. Reliability:
   - Multi-AZ deployment
   - Health checks and auto-recovery
   - Database backups
   - Load balancing

## Next steps

1. Design database models (Users, Games, Predictions, Leagues, etc.)
2. Implement API endpoints
3. Build frontend pages and components
4. Add tests
5. Set up CI/CD pipeline

The foundation is ready. You can start local development with `docker-compose up` or follow the deployment guide to set up on AWS.

_**User (2025-11-22 20:18Z)**_

Ok, now let's design the database models. A few models I can think: 

- User  : information about users that will log in the website

- Prediction : information about users games predictions. This model could have an attribute to save the user score for that specific prediction 

- Game: information about a match (teams involved, game date and time, stadium, result, etc). The games of the group stage are predefined before the tourney starts (meaning we know which team faces who), but only after group stage is complete we will know the games of the knockout round as they happen

- Team : information about a national team ( we won't need details about players that makes up the team, as it won't be relevant for the predictions) 

- Group : The first phase of the world cup is comprised by a Group Stage , before the Knockout round. A

 group has teams and games linked to it

- League: A league of predictions created by an User that comprises that User and other Users where they compete among themselves . 



For now that's all I can think. Anything else I might be missing you spot in this?

```diff
+
```

```diff
+     status = Column(SQLEnum(GameStatus), default=GameStatus.SCHEDULED, nullable=False, index=True)

+     home_score = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
+     away_score = Column(Integer, nullable=True)

+     # Penalty shootout scores (if applicable)
+     home_penalty_score = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
+     away_penalty_score = Column(Integer, nullable=True)

+     # Stadium and round information
+     stadium_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(&quot;stadiums.id&quot;), nullable=True, index=True)

+

+     created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)

+     
+     # Relationships
+     home_team = relationship(&quot;Team&quot;, foreign_keys=[home_team_id], back_populates=&quot;home_games&quot;)

+     stadium = relationship(&quot;Stadium&quot;, back_populates=&quot;games&quot;)
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,389 @@
- 
+ # Database Schema Documentation
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This document describes the database schema for the World Cup Predictions platform.
+ 
+ ## Entity Relationship Diagram
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ ┌──────────┐         ┌──────────────┐         ┌──────────┐
+ │   User   │────────│  Prediction  │────────│   Game   │
+ └────┬─────┘         └──────────────┘         └────┬─────┘
+      │                                              │
+      │                                              │
+      │         ┌──────────────┐                    │
+      │────────│ LeagueMember │                    │
+      │         └──────┬───────┘                    │
+      │                │                            │
+      │         ┌───────▼───────┐                    │
+      │         │    League     │                    │
+      │         └───────┬───────┘                    │
+      │                │                            │
+      │         ┌───────▼────────┐                  │
+      │         │LeagueInvitation│                  │
+      │         └────────────────┘                 │
+      │                                              │
+ ┌────▼────┐                                    ┌───▼────┐
+ │  Team  │                                    │ Stadium│
+ └────┬───┘                                    └────────┘
+      │
+      │         ┌──────────────┐
+      │────────│  GroupTeam   │────────┐
+      │         └──────────────┘        │
+      │                                 │
+ ┌────▼────┐                    ┌───────▼────┐
+ │  Group  │                    │    Round   │
+ └────┬────┘                    └───────┬────┘
+      │                                  │
+      │                                  │
+      └──────────┬───────────────────────┘
+                 │
+            ┌────▼────┐
+            │  Game   │
+            └─────────┘
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Models
+ 
+ ### User
+ **Table:** &#96;users&#96;
+ 
+ Stores user account information for authentication and profiles.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;email&#96;: String, unique, indexed
+ - &#96;username&#96;: String, unique, indexed
+ - &#96;hashed_password&#96;: String (bcrypt hash)
+ - &#96;is_active&#96;: Boolean, default True
+ - &#96;is_superuser&#96;: Boolean, default False
+ - &#96;created_at&#96;: DateTime
+ - &#96;updated_at&#96;: DateTime
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - One-to-many with &#96;Prediction&#96;
+ - One-to-many with &#96;League&#96; (as creator)
+ - Many-to-many with &#96;League&#96; (via &#96;LeagueMember&#96;)
+ - One-to-many with &#96;LeagueInvitation&#96; (as inviter and invitee)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### Team
+ **Table:** &#96;teams&#96;
+ 
+ Stores national team information.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;name&#96;: String, unique, indexed (e.g., &quot;Brazil&quot;, &quot;Argentina&quot;)
+ - &#96;country_code&#96;: String(3), unique, indexed (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, e.g., &quot;BRA&quot;, &quot;ARG&quot;)
+ - &#96;flag_emoji&#96;: String(10), optional (flag emoji for display)
+ - &#96;fifa_ranking&#96;: Integer, optional (current FIFA ranking)
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - One-to-many with &#96;Game&#96; (as home_team and away_team)
+ - Many-to-many with &#96;Group&#96; (via &#96;GroupTeam&#96;)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### Stadium
+ **Table:** &#96;stadiums&#96;
+ 
+ Stores stadium/venue information for matches.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;name&#96;: String, indexed
+ - &#96;city&#96;: String
+ - &#96;capacity&#96;: Integer, optional
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - One-to-many with &#96;Game&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### Round
+ **Table:** &#96;rounds&#96;
+ 
+ Stores tournament round/phase information.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;name&#96;: String, unique, indexed (e.g., &quot;Group A&quot;, &quot;Round of 16&quot;, &quot;Final&quot;)
+ - &#96;round_type&#96;: Enum (RoundType), indexed
+   - &#96;GROUP_STAGE&#96;
+   - &#96;ROUND_OF_16&#96;
+   - &#96;QUARTER_FINALS&#96;
+   - &#96;SEMI_FINALS&#96;
+   - &#96;THIRD_PLACE&#96;
+   - &#96;FINAL&#96;
+ - &#96;order&#96;: Integer, indexed (tournament order: 1=Group Stage, 2=Round of 16, etc.)
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - One-to-many with &#96;Game&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### Group
+ **Table:** &#96;groups&#96;
+ 
+ Stores group stage group information.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;name&#96;: String, unique, indexed (e.g., &quot;Group A&quot;, &quot;Group B&quot;)
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-many with &#96;Team&#96; (via &#96;GroupTeam&#96;)
+ - One-to-many with &#96;Game&#96; (only for group stage games)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### GroupTeam
+ **Table:** &#96;group_teams&#96;
+ 
+ Association table linking teams to groups (many-to-many).
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;group_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;groups.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;team_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;teams.id&#96;, indexed
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Group&#96;
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Team&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### Game
+ **Table:** &#96;games&#96;
+ 
+ Stores match/game information.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;home_team_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;teams.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;away_team_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;teams.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;scheduled_at&#96;: DateTime, indexed
+ - &#96;status&#96;: Enum (GameStatus), indexed
+   - &#96;SCHEDULED&#96;
+   - &#96;LIVE&#96;
+   - &#96;FINISHED&#96;
+   - &#96;CANCELLED&#96;
+   - &#96;POSTPONED&#96;
+ - &#96;home_score&#96;: Integer, nullable (set when game finishes)
+ - &#96;away_score&#96;: Integer, nullable
+ - &#96;home_penalty_score&#96;: Integer, nullable (for penalty shootouts)
+ - &#96;away_penalty_score&#96;: Integer, nullable
+ - &#96;stadium_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;stadiums.id&#96;, nullable, indexed
+ - &#96;round_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;rounds.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;group_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;groups.id&#96;, nullable, indexed (only for group stage)
+ - &#96;is_knockout&#96;: Boolean, default False, indexed
+ - &#96;match_number&#96;: Integer, optional
+ - &#96;created_at&#96;: DateTime
+ - &#96;updated_at&#96;: DateTime
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Team&#96; (home_team and away_team)
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Stadium&#96;
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Round&#96;
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Group&#96; (optional, for group stage)
+ - One-to-many with &#96;Prediction&#96;
+ 
+ **Notes:**
+ - Group stage games have &#96;group_id&#96; set and &#96;is_knockout=False&#96;
+ - Knockout games have &#96;group_id=null&#96; and &#96;is_knockout=True&#96;
+ - Knockout games are created dynamically as the tournament progresses
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### Prediction
+ **Table:** &#96;predictions&#96;
+ 
+ Stores user predictions for games.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;user_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;users.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;game_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;games.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;predicted_home_score&#96;: Integer
+ - &#96;predicted_away_score&#96;: Integer
+ - &#96;points&#96;: Integer, default 0, indexed (total points earned)
+ - &#96;exact_score_points&#96;: Integer, default 0 (points for exact score match)
+ - &#96;correct_result_points&#96;: Integer, default 0 (points for correct winner/draw)
+ - &#96;correct_goal_difference_points&#96;: Integer, default 0 (points for correct goal difference)
+ - &#96;is_calculated&#96;: Boolean, default False, indexed
+ - &#96;created_at&#96;: DateTime
+ - &#96;updated_at&#96;: DateTime
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;User&#96;
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;Game&#96;
+ 
+ **Constraints:**
+ - Unique constraint on (&#96;user_id&#96;, &#96;game_id&#96;) - one prediction per user per game
+ 
+ **Scoring Logic:**
+ Points are calculated after a game finishes:
+ - Exact score match: Highest points (e.g., 10 points)
+ - Correct result (winner/draw): Medium points (e.g., 5 points)
+ - Correct goal difference: Lower points (e.g., 2 points)
+ - Points breakdown stored for transparency
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### League
+ **Table:** &#96;leagues&#96;
+ 
+ Stores private prediction leagues.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;name&#96;: String, indexed
+ - &#96;description&#96;: String, nullable
+ - &#96;created_by&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;users.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;is_private&#96;: Boolean, default True, indexed
+ - &#96;invite_code&#96;: String, unique, nullable, indexed (for joining via code)
+ - &#96;created_at&#96;: DateTime
+ - &#96;updated_at&#96;: DateTime
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;User&#96; (as creator)
+ - One-to-many with &#96;LeagueMember&#96;
+ - One-to-many with &#96;LeagueInvitation&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### LeagueMember
+ **Table:** &#96;league_members&#96;
+ 
+ Association table linking users to leagues with additional metadata (many-to-many).
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;league_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;leagues.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;user_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;users.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;total_points&#96;: Integer, default 0, indexed (league-specific score)
+ - &#96;joined_at&#96;: DateTime
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;League&#96;
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;User&#96;
+ 
+ **Constraints:**
+ - Unique constraint on (&#96;league_id&#96;, &#96;user_id&#96;) - one membership per user per league
+ 
+ **Notes:**
+ - &#96;total_points&#96; is the sum of all prediction points for games in this league
+ - Updated when predictions are scored
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ### LeagueInvitation
+ **Table:** &#96;league_invitations&#96;
+ 
+ Stores league invitation information.
+ 
+ **Fields:**
+ - &#96;id&#96; (PK): Integer, auto-increment
+ - &#96;league_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;leagues.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;inviter_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;users.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;invitee_id&#96; (FK): Integer → &#96;users.id&#96;, indexed
+ - &#96;status&#96;: String, default &quot;pending&quot;, indexed
+   - &#96;pending&#96;: Invitation sent, awaiting response
+   - &#96;accepted&#96;: Invitation accepted
+   - &#96;rejected&#96;: Invitation rejected
+   - &#96;expired&#96;: Invitation expired
+ - &#96;created_at&#96;: DateTime
+ - &#96;expires_at&#96;: DateTime, nullable (optional expiration)
+ - &#96;responded_at&#96;: DateTime, nullable
+ 
+ **Relationships:**
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;League&#96;
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;User&#96; (as inviter)
+ - Many-to-one with &#96;User&#96; (as invitee)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Indexes
+ 
+ ### Performance Indexes
+ 
+ The following indexes are created for optimal query performance:
+ 
+ 1. **User:**
+    - &#96;email&#96; (unique)
+    - &#96;username&#96; (unique)
+ 
+ 2. **Game:**
+    - &#96;scheduled_at&#96; (for querying upcoming games)
+    - &#96;status&#96; (for filtering by game status)
+    - &#96;round_id&#96; (for querying games by round)
+    - &#96;group_id&#96; (for querying group stage games)
+    - &#96;is_knockout&#96; (for filtering knockout games)
+ 
+ 3. **Prediction:**
+    - &#96;user_id&#96; (for user&#39;s predictions)
+    - &#96;game_id&#96; (for game predictions)
+    - &#96;points&#96; (for leaderboard queries)
+    - &#96;is_calculated&#96; (for batch processing)
+    - Unique: (&#96;user_id&#96;, &#96;game_id&#96;)
+ 
+ 4. **LeagueMember:**
+    - &#96;league_id&#96; (for league members)
+    - &#96;user_id&#96; (for user&#39;s leagues)
+    - &#96;total_points&#96; (for league leaderboards)
+    - Unique: (&#96;league_id&#96;, &#96;user_id&#96;)
+ 
+ 5. **LeagueInvitation:**
+    - &#96;status&#96; (for filtering pending invitations)
+    - &#96;invitee_id&#96; (for user&#39;s received invitations)
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Key Design Decisions
+ 
+ 1. **Separate Round and Group Models:**
+    - &#96;Round&#96; handles tournament phases (Group Stage, Round of 16, etc.)
+    - &#96;Group&#96; handles specific groups within the group stage (Group A, B, etc.)
+    - This allows flexibility for knockout rounds which don&#39;t have groups
+ 
+ 2. **Prediction Points Breakdown:**
+    - Stores detailed point breakdown (exact score, correct result, goal difference)
+    - Enables transparency and allows for scoring rule changes without recalculating
+ 
+ 3. **League-Specific Scoring:**
+    - &#96;LeagueMember.total_points&#96; stores league-specific scores
+    - Allows different leagues to have different scoring rules in the future
+    - Enables efficient leaderboard queries per league
+ 
+ 4. **Game Status Enum:**
+    - Tracks game lifecycle (scheduled → live → finished)
+    - Enables filtering and prevents predictions after game starts
+ 
+ 5. **Invite Code System:**
+    - &#96;League.invite_code&#96; allows easy joining via code
+    - Alternative to invitation system for public/private leagues
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Future Enhancements
+ 
+ Potential additions for future versions:
+ 
+ 1. **UserScore Table:**
+    - Cache global user scores for performance
+    - Updated via triggers or background jobs
+ 
+ 2. **PredictionHistory:**
+    - Track prediction changes (if users can edit predictions)
+ 
+ 3. **Notification System:**
+    - Track game start notifications
+    - League invitation notifications
+ 
+ 4. **Tournament Model:**
+    - Support multiple tournaments (not just World Cup)
+    - Link games, teams, and rounds to tournaments
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

Created the database models. Summary:

## Models created

### Core models (as requested):
1. **User** — Authentication and user information
2. **Team** — National teams with country codes and FIFA rankings
3. **Game** — Match information with teams, scores, status, stadium, and round
4. **Group** — Group stage groups (Group A, B, etc.)
5. **Prediction** — User predictions with point calculation breakdown
6. **League** — Private leagues with invite codes

### Additional models:
1. **LeagueMember** — Many-to-many relationship between Users and Leagues with league-specific scoring
2. **LeagueInvitation** — Tracks pending invitations with status and expiration
3. **Round** — Tournament phases (Group Stage, Round of 16, Quarter-finals, Semi-finals, Final)
4. **Stadium** — Venue information for matches
5. **GroupTeam** — Association table linking teams to groups

## Features

1. Scoring system:
   - Points breakdown (exact score, correct result, goal difference)
   - `is_calculated` flag for batch processing
   - League-specific scores in `LeagueMember.total_points`

2. Game management:
   - Status enum (scheduled, live, finished, cancelled, postponed)
   - Supports penalty shootouts
   - `is_knockout` flag to distinguish group stage from knockout
   - `group_id` only for group stage games (null for knockout)

3. League system:
   - Invite codes for easy joining
   - Invitation tracking with status
   - League-specific leaderboards via `LeagueMember.total_points`

4. Indexes:
   - Indexes on frequently queried fields
   - Unique constraints to prevent duplicates

## Next steps

1. Create the initial migration:
   ```bash
   cd backend
   alembic revision --autogenerate -m "Initial database schema"
   alembic upgrade head
   ```

2. Review the schema documentation in `backend/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md`

3. Test the models with sample data

## 1. Team–Game relationship

The relationship exists. Each `Game` has:
- `home_team_id` (FK to `teams.id`)
- `away_team_id` (FK to `teams.id`)
- Relationships: `home_team` and `away_team`

Each `Team` has:
- `home_games` — games where the team is home
- `away_games` — games where the team is away

So a `Game` always has exactly 2 teams, and a `Team` can be in many games.

To get all games for a team:
```python
# Option 1: Access both relationships
all_games = team.home_games + team.away_games

# Option 2: Query with SQLAlchemy OR
from sqlalchemy import or_
games = session.query(Game).filter(
    or_(Game.home_team_id == team.id, Game.away_team_id == team.id)
).all()
```

## 2. GroupTeam after group stage

`GroupTeam` records are historical and remain in the database after the group stage ends. They represent which teams were in which groups during the group stage.

Why keep them:
- Historical record of group stage composition
- Useful for statistics and queries
- Displaying group stage results
- Understanding tournament progression

When knockout rounds begin:
- Teams advance based on group stage results
- New knockout games are created (with `is_knockout=True` and `group_id=null`)
- `GroupTeam` records are not deleted — they remain as permanent historical data

This is standard practice: keep historical data for analytics and records.

I've updated the models and documentation to clarify both points. The relationships are now more explicit, and there's a note in `GroupTeam` explaining that these records are permanent historical data.

_**Agent (model default, mode Ask)**_



---


To open the Builder.io extension in Cursor:

1. Command Palette (recommended):
   - Press `Cmd+Shift+P` (Mac) or `Ctrl+Shift+P` (Windows/Linux)
   - Type "Builder" or "Builder.io"
   - Select the command to open Builder.io

2. Sidebar:
   - Check the left sidebar for a Builder.io icon
   - If not visible, right-click the sidebar and enable it

3. View menu:
   - Go to `View` → `Open View...`
   - Search for "Builder"

4. Restart:
   - If it doesn’t appear, restart Cursor once
   - After restart, try the Command Palette again

5. Check installation:
   - Open Extensions (`Cmd+Shift+X` / `Ctrl+Shift+X`)
   - Search "Builder.io"
   - Confirm it’s installed and enabled

Builder.io typically adds a panel or opens in a new view. If it still doesn’t appear after a restart, check the extension’s documentation for specific activation steps.

If you want, I can help you integrate Builder.io designs into your React frontend.

```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ Pydantic schemas for authentication endpoints.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field, field_validator
+ from typing import Optional
+ from datetime import datetime
+ 
+ 
+ class UserBase(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Base user schema.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     email: EmailStr
+     username: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=50)
+ 
+ 
+ class UserCreate(UserBase):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for user signup.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     password: str = Field(..., min_length=8, max_length=100)
+     
+     @field_validator(&#39;password&#39;)
+     @classmethod
+     def validate_password(cls, v: str) -&gt; str:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Validate password strength.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if len(v) &lt; 8:
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must be at least 8 characters long&#39;)
+         if not any(c.isupper() for c in v):
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must contain at least one uppercase letter&#39;)
+         if not any(c.islower() for c in v):
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must contain at least one lowercase letter&#39;)
+         if not any(c.isdigit() for c in v):
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must contain at least one digit&#39;)
+         return v
+ 
+ 
+ class UserResponse(UserBase):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for user response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     id: int
+     is_active: bool
+     email_verified: bool
+     created_at: datetime
+     
+     class Config:
+         from_attributes = True
+ 
+ 
+ class Token(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for authentication token.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     access_token: str
+     token_type: str = &quot;bearer&quot;
+ 
+ 
+ class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for login request.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     email: EmailStr
+     password: str
+ 
+ 
+ class LoginResponse(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for login response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     access_token: str
+     token_type: str = &quot;bearer&quot;
+     user: UserResponse
+ 
+ 
+ class SignupResponse(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for signup response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     user: UserResponse
+     message: str
+ 
+ 
+ class VerifyEmailRequest(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for email verification request.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     token: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
+ 
+ 
+ class VerifyEmailResponse(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for email verification response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     message: str
+ 
+ 
+ class ResendVerificationRequest(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for resend verification email request.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     email: EmailStr
+ 
+ 
+ class ResendVerificationResponse(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for resend verification response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     message: str
+ 
+ 
+ class ForgotPasswordRequest(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for forgot password request.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     email: EmailStr
+ 
+ 
+ class ForgotPasswordResponse(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for forgot password response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     message: str
+ 
+ 
+ class ResetPasswordRequest(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for reset password request.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     token: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
+     new_password: str = Field(..., min_length=8, max_length=100)
+     
+     @field_validator(&#39;new_password&#39;)
+     @classmethod
+     def validate_password(cls, v: str) -&gt; str:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Validate password strength.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if len(v) &lt; 8:
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must be at least 8 characters long&#39;)
+         if not any(c.isupper() for c in v):
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must contain at least one uppercase letter&#39;)
+         if not any(c.islower() for c in v):
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must contain at least one lowercase letter&#39;)
+         if not any(c.isdigit() for c in v):
+             raise ValueError(&#39;Password must contain at least one digit&#39;)
+         return v
+ 
+ 
+ class ResetPasswordResponse(BaseModel):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Schema for reset password response.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     message: str
+ 
```
